environment.description: Kubernetes deployment on EKS 1.28 with default namespace. Pod runs as root (UID 0) with default service account. Container image based on ubuntu:22.04 with full shell utilities. No PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforced. Volume mount uses hostPath /var/data mapped to /data inside container. No network policies applied. The container has SYS_ADMIN capability and privileged: true in securityContext.
